#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <queue>
#include <algorithm>
#include <cstring>
using namespace std;

class HopcroftKarpBipartiteMatching {
public:
    int m, n;
    vector<vector<int>> g;
    vector<int> pairU;
    vector<int> pairV;
    vector<int> dis;
    const int inf = 10000000;
    const int NIL = 0;

    HopcroftKarpBipartiteMatching(int m, int n, vector<vector<int>>& g) : m(m), n(n), g(g), pairU(m + 1, NIL), pairV(n + 1, NIL), dis(m + 1) {}

    int maximumMatching() {
        fill(pairU.begin(), pairU.end(), NIL);
        fill(pairV.begin(), pairV.end(), NIL);

        int maxMatching = 0;

        while (bfs()) {
            for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) {
                if (pairU[i] == NIL && dfs(i))
                    maxMatching++;
            }
        }

        return maxMatching;
    }

    bool bfs() {
        queue<int> queue;

        for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) {
            if (pairU[i] == NIL) {
                queue.push(i);
                dis[i] = 0;
            } else {
                dis[i] = inf;
            }
        }

        dis[NIL] = inf;

        while (!queue.empty()) {
            int u = queue.front();
            queue.pop();

            if (dis[u] < dis[NIL]) {
                for (int v : g[u]) {
                    if (dis[pairV[v]] == inf) {
                        queue.push(pairV[v]);
                        dis[pairV[v]] = dis[u] + 2;
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        return dis[NIL] < inf;
    }

    bool dfs(int u) {
        if (u != NIL) {
            for (int v : g[u]) {
                if (dis[pairV[v]] == dis[u] + 2) {
                    if (dfs(pairV[v])) {
                        pairV[v] = u;
                        pairU[u] = v;
                        return true;
                    }
                }
            }
            dis[u] = inf;
            return false;
        } else
            return true;
    }
};

class _1047D {
public:
    int n, m;

    void solve(int testNumber, int& in_n, int& in_m) {
        n = in_n;
        m = in_m;

        long long ans = 0;

        if (n > 100) {
            int nn = (n - 100) % 6;
            long long nq = (n - 100) / 6;
            ans += nq * 6 * m;
            n = 100 + nn;
        }

        if (m > 100) {
            int nm = (m - 100) % 6;
            long long mq = (m - 100) / 6;
            ans += mq * 6 * n;
            m = 100 + nm;
        }

        vector<vector<int>> mat(n + 1, vector<int>(m + 1, 0));

        int u = 1;
        int v = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= m; j++) {
                if ((i + j) % 2 == 0) {
                    mat[i][j] = u;
                    u++;
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= m; j++) {
                if ((i + j) % 2 != 0) {
                    mat[i][j] = v;
                    v++;
                }
            }
        }

        vector<vector<int>> g(u);

        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= m; j++) {
                if ((i + j) % 2 == 0) {
                    addEdge(mat, g, i, j, i - 3, j);
                    addEdge(mat, g, i, j, i - 2, j - 1);
                    addEdge(mat, g, i, j, i - 2, j + 1);
                    addEdge(mat, g, i, j, i, j - 3);
                    addEdge(mat, g, i, j, i - 1, j - 2);
                    addEdge(mat, g, i, j, i + 1, j - 2);
                    addEdge(mat, g, i, j, i, j + 3);
                    addEdge(mat, g, i, j, i - 1, j + 2);
                    addEdge(mat, g, i, j, i + 1, j + 2);
                    addEdge(mat, g, i, j, i + 3, j);
                    addEdge(mat, g, i, j, i + 2, j - 1);
                    addEdge(mat, g, i, j, i + 2, j + 1);
                }
            }
        }

        HopcroftKarpBipartiteMatching bpm(u - 1, v - 1, g);

        ans += 2 * bpm.maximumMatching();

        cout << ans << endl;
    }

    void addEdge(vector<vector<int>>& mat, vector<vector<int>>& g, int i, int j, int s, int t) {
        if (s <= 0 || t <= 0 || s > n || t > m)
            return;

        g[mat[i][j]].push_back(mat[s][t]);
    }
};

int main() {
    int n, m;
    cin >> n >> m;

    _1047D solver;
    solver.solve(1, n, m);

    return 0;
}
